candidates.change_summary: Replace the call result handling to ignore the returned success flag and not require success (removes require), changing whether failing external calls revert and thus can change state observable after forward.

Invert the success check to require the call to fail (require(!_s)), causing forward to revert on successful callee calls and only proceed when the callee call returns false, altering observable behavior.
Change the low-level call to a delegatecall so the callee's execution runs in the caller's context, which can change state observed after forward.
Change the low-level call to a staticcall, making the callee unable to modify state; this can alter observable behavior following forward.
Insert forwarding of all available gas using call with gas(left) parameter, changing gas behavior and potentially the observable success of forwarded calls.
